title: Timezone Picker
summary: Finds time zones by city, country or abbreviation and lists every meaning of ambiguous ones like IST or CST instead of guessing.
description: Time zone search by city, country or abbreviation, listing every meaning of ambiguous abbreviations (IST, CST) instead of guessing, with local time and UTC offset per result, warnings for an upcoming clock change and a zone that differs from the device's.
catches: Ambiguous abbreviations, with all their meanings
A pick that differs from the device's zone, with use-device option
Local time and UTC offset for each result
limits: Search covers popular zones and aliases; obscure zones may need the IANA name
Offsets come from the runtime's tz database
a11y: Visible <label>; input is a combobox with aria-expanded, aria-controls and aria-activedescendant
Arrow keys move, Enter picks, Escape clears
Results are a listbox of options with aria-selected; status is role=status
stops: Meeting scheduled in the wrong zone
